pairs: A Canticle Psalm to the sons of Korah.
pro Maheleth ad respondendum. Intellectus Eman Ezrahitæ.
For Mahalath, to answer the understanding of Heman the Ezrahite.
in die clamavi et nocte coram te.
I have cried out, day and night, in your presence.
Intret in conspectu tuo oratio mea,
Let my prayer enter in your sight.
inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam.
Incline your ear to my petition.
Quia repleta est malis anima mea,
For my soul has been filled with evils,
and my life has drawn near to Hell.
Æstimatus sum cum descendentibus in lacum,
I am considered to be among those who will descend into the pit.
factus sum sicut homo sine adjutorio,
I have become like a man without assistance,
I am like the wounded sleeping in sepulchers,
et ipsi de manu tua repulsi sunt.
and who have been repelled by your hand.
They have lain me in the lower pit:
and in the shadow of death.
Super me confirmatus est furor tuus,
Your fury has been confirmed over me.
et omnes fluctus tuos induxisti super me.
And you have brought all your waves upon me.
Longe fecisti notos meos a me;
You have sent my acquaintances far from me.
They have set me as an abomination to themselves.
I stretched out my hands to you.
Will you perform wonders for the dead?
Or will physicians raise to life,
Numquid narrabit aliquis in sepulchro misericordiam tuam,
Could anyone declare your mercy in the sepulcher,
or your truth from within perdition?
Numquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia tua?
Will your wonders be known in the darkness,
et justitia tua in terra oblivionis?
or your justice in the land of oblivion?
And I have cried out to you,
et mane oratio mea præveniet te.
my prayer will come before you.
why do you reject my prayer?
Why do you turn your face away from me?
et in laboribus a juventute mea;
and I have been amid hardships from my youth.
Your wrath has crossed into me,
and your terrors have disturbed me.
circumdederunt me sicut aqua tota die;
They have surrounded me like water, all day long.
They have surrounded me, all at once.
Elongasti a me amicum et proximum,
Friend and neighbor, and my acquaintances,
you have sent far away from me, away from misery.
